room.label: Exam room
room.hint: The school tells you the room for each paper. Until it does, leave it on “Not sure yet”: the times of the main hall are shown.

acc2.heading: ACC2 start times
acc2.intro: In ACC2 each paper starts at the time below. Your end time is that start plus the printed duration.

clash.title: Possible clash
clash.text: {{date}}, {{hall}}: {{first}} ({{firstFrom}}–{{firstTo}}) overlaps with {{second}} (from {{secondFrom}}). Check the room and the start times with the school.
